narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed and moved southwest across eastern Pinal and Pima counties during the early morning hours. Flash flooding occurred in northern and western parts of the Tucson Metro area. Lightning also started a small house fire.
ev: Heavy rain of 1 to 1.5 in 90 minutes west of Interstate 10 and north of Highway 86 in Tucson resulted in flash flooding and the closure of several roads including Bopp Rd, Jamie Ave, Aldon Rd, and Sandario Rd. A vehicle was stranded in floodwaters at Sweetwater and Silverbell.

Strong flows continued in the Canada Del Oro Wash as a result of 1 to 2 of rain in less than an hour in the upper reaches of the basin within the Bighorn burn scar. Overton Rd. was closed due to flooding and the loop trail at Christina Taylor Green Park was flooded. More than an inch of rain in less than 1 hour also occurred from Marana to the southern Tortolita Mountains. As a result a swift water rescue was performed near Grier and Sandario and another west of Edwin and Oracle Rds.
More than 1 inch of rain in less than 1 hour caused flash flooding in Cactus Forest and the closure of Quail Ridge Way near Diffin Rd.

Heavy rain of 1 to 2 in less than an hour in the upper reaches of the Canada Del Oro Wash within the Bighorn burn scar caused rapid rises downstream. Rail North Rd along Lago Del Oro Parkway to Wilds Rd was closed to high water levels.
lsr: PINAL COUNTY SHERIFFS DISPATCH REPORTS ROAD CLOSURES ON COOPER ROAD BETWEEN ARIZONA FARMS ROAD AND JUDD ROAD DUE TO RUNNING WASHES.
PINAL COUNTY SHERIFFS DEPARTMENT REPORTED A ROAD CLOSURE AT QUAIL RIDGE WAY AND DIFFIN ROAD IN CACTUS FOREST.
NORTHWEST FIRE CONDUCTED A SWIFT WATER RESCUE ON A DRIVER FROM THEIR VEHICLE IN THE AREA OF GRIER ROAD AND SANDARIO ROAD.
